scope: second-phase long-window signed-action robustness and drag/lift/torque-cost audit; not tuning or closed-loop acceptance
action_rule: omega ramps linearly from 0 to target during first 2 D/U, then holds

torque_cost_definition.guards: also report positive-only and absolute proxies; do not call any proxy electrical motor energy

leakage_audit.method: compare raw OpenFOAM t=90 U/p SHA-256 against every case in current checkpoint and independent-phase train/validation/test splits
